headline: Now Google’s Familiar Faces AI feature works on Walmart’s $35 smart home camera too
summary: Google's AI 'Familiar Faces' feature now supports specific Walmart Onn smart cameras. This facial recognition tech is available on Onn Outdoor and Floodlight cameras. A Google Home Premium subscription is required to use this feature.

headline: Amazon loses its latest attempt to get out of handling more recall notices
summary: Amazon lost a legal battle against the CPSC regarding product recalls. The US District Court ruled Amazon is a distributor, not just a logistics provider. Amazon is now responsible for recalling over 400,000 hazardous products.

headline: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
summary: Google filed a patent for 'My Channel,' an AI-generated personalized video and ad feed. The patent, though rejected, raises concerns about the future of entertainment. Google may appeal or resubmit an amended version of the patent.

headline: US approves SpaceX plan to send a million data satellites to space
summary: The US has approved SpaceX's ambitious plan for a million data satellites. The 'Starmind' constellation aims to meet rising AI computing demand. This initiative seeks to be highly cost and energy-efficient.

headline: Stalking law simplified to become one offence
summary: Stalking legislation in the UK is being simplified. A review found existing laws were confusing and ineffective. The new change aims to consolidate multiple offenses into one clear law.

headline: Expect fewer frosts and more hot days as UK seasons shift, says Met Office
summary: The UK Met Office predicts significant seasonal shifts for the UK. Expect fewer frosts and an increase in hot days. These changes are impacting wildlife and prompting farmers to adapt crops.
